title: Phase 3 Study of RLY-2608 + Fulvestrant vs Capivasertib + Fulvestrant as Treatment for Locally Advanced or Metastatic PIK3CA-mutant HR+/​HER2- Breast Cancer (ReDiscover-2)

rules.rule_text: Age at least 18 years
rules.source_text: Minimum age: 18 Years

rules.rule_text: ECOG performance status 0 or 1
rules.source_text: Patient has ECOG performance status of 0-1

rules.rule_text: One or more known primary oncogenic PIK3CA mutation(s)
rules.source_text: One or more known primary oncogenic PIK3CA mutation(s)

rules.rule_text: Adult female or male; pre-menopausal women require GnRH agonist initiation at least 2 weeks prior to randomization with willingness to continue for duration of study
rules.source_text: Adult females, pre- and/or post-menopausal, and adult males. Pre-menopausal (and peri-menopausal) women can be enrolled if amenable to treatment with a gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonist. Patients are to have commenced treatment with a GnRH agonist at least 2 weeks prior to randomization and must be willing to continue on it for the duration of the study.
rules.notes: Pre-menopausal/peri-menopausal women require specific GnRH agonist timing and commitment

rules.rule_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
rules.source_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer (ABC) with radiological or objective evidence of recurrence or progression; locally advanced disease must not be amenable to resection with curative intent
rules.notes: Locally advanced disease must not be amenable to resection with curative intent

rules.rule_text: Radiological or objective evidence of recurrence or progression of breast cancer
rules.source_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer (ABC) with radiological or objective evidence of recurrence or progression; locally advanced disease must not be amenable to resection with curative intent

rules.rule_text: Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 or evaluable bone-only disease
rules.source_text: Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 or evaluable bone-only disease.

rules.rule_text: At least 1 and no more than 2 lines of endocrine therapy in (neo)adjuvant setting with recurrence on or within 12 months of completion
rules.source_text: At least 1 and no more than 2 lines of endocrine therapy (ET) in the (neo)adjuvant setting with recurrence on or within 12 months of completion or in the ABC setting
rules.notes: Addresses prior endocrine therapy lines and timing requirements

rules.rule_text: Radiological evidence of progression on or after at least 1 and no more than 2 lines of endocrine therapy in ABC setting
rules.source_text: At least 1 and no more than 2 lines of endocrine therapy (ET) in the (neo)adjuvant setting with recurrence on or within 12 months of completion or in the ABC setting

rules.rule_text: CDK4/6 inhibitor + endocrine therapy in ABC setting as only prior CDK4/6 line
rules.source_text: Only 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy in one of the following settings: CDK4/6 inhibitor + ET in the ABC setting
rules.notes: Only 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor allowed

rules.rule_text: CDK4/6 inhibitor in adjuvant setting with progression during or within 12 months of completion as only prior CDK4/6 line
rules.source_text: Only 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy in one of the following settings: CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy in the adjuvant setting if progression occurred during or within 12 months of completion of adjuvant CDK4/6 inhibitor with ET
rules.notes: Only 1 prior line of CDK4/6 inhibitor allowed
